_comment: The defaults the desktop app and the TypeScript side share, kept only here: Rust compiles this file in (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/defaults.rs) and TS imports it (./defaults.ts — the website, CI and the scripts). colors + style are the map a fresh install draws; maxHalfKm sizes every map and is a contract with data already published, so read MAX_HALF_KM in ./defaults.ts before changing it.
